sourceMaterials.text:
# Pelican Lakeside Bike Ride

Creator and submitter: [UnclK (@Kedashu)](https://x.com/Kedashu), maintainer of [Pelican Map](https://pelicanmap.aveniqa.com/).

Model: Gemini 4 Argon, using the Gemini web app. The creator reports that the supplied HTML was produced in a single generation. This is a creator-reported workflow, not an independently reproduced benchmark.

Original prompt (verbatim):

> 做一个SVG的鹈鹕骑自行车在公路骑行的，动画。公路边是湖水

The complete supplied HTML is preserved as `index.html`. It includes its original SVG, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CDN reference and Google Fonts reference. The MP4 is a browser recording of this code running, not text-to-video generation.

Original HTML SHA-256: `3fe564b5d0aa6bae12d9d72a89027a5ccef14a3b7606ae6861add1ea5952a488`.

Interactive actions include catching fish, honking, changing riding speed, and switching between day, sunset and night. No open-source license is asserted by this publication. Third-party dependencies retain their own terms.
